role: A sufficient coefficient-serialization interface for GCG4, not an equivalent reformulation.

object.selector: actual prime endpoints incident to physical adjacent-prime gaps at most Y^(161/1000)
object.weights: the exact retained and normalized adjacent-gap hat coefficients
object.dyadic_bins: the O(log Y) remaining classes in which lambda_p is within a factor two of a common level
object.quantifiers: every sufficiently large admissible Y and every non-tiny dyadic bin of this one fixed vector

target.statement: For each bin P_j, integral from L to 2B of |sum_{p in P_j} lambda_p exp(it log(p/Y))|^4 dt is at most Y^(13/8+o(1)) E_j^2, where E_j=sum_{p in P_j}lambda_p^2.
target.strength_warning: This binwise theorem is stronger than global GCG4 because it forbids cancellation between coefficient levels. Failure prunes this interface, not GCG4.

proved_adapter.tiny_bin: There are O(Y) primes, so its l1 norm is O(Y^(-1/2)) and its fourth moment is O(Y^(-16/33)).
proved_adapter.conclusion: The binwise target implies GCG4 with only Y^o(1) loss.

licensed_falsifiers.abstract: False for arbitrary prime subsets selected to phase-align; the actual adjacent-gap selector is mandatory.
licensed_falsifiers.fejer: An absolute close-pair/positive-kernel estimate returns the generic Y^2 term.
licensed_falsifiers.prime_density_pseudonodes: Odd-half-grid controls violate the desired high-tail behavior while preserving coarse geometry.
licensed_falsifiers.finite: Frozen vectors are twin-edge-only and cannot test the asymptotic mixed-gap bins.

literature_stop.strongest_direct_sparse_import: Matomaki--Teravainen Lemma 3.4 returns Y^2 E_j^2 and misses Y^(13/8) E_j^2 by Y^(3/8).
literature_stop.guth_maynard: At the favorable dense-bin normalization the T-dependent large-value term still misses by Y^(383/1320); direct weighted normalization misses by Y^(279047/429000).
literature_stop.decision: No existing theorem closes the target. Continue only with an adjacent-gap-sensitive improvement; do not iterate coefficient-blind large-value estimates.
